paper_title: Robust bounds on ALP dark matter from dwarf spheroidal galaxies in the optical MUSE-Faint survey
notes: 95% C.L. upper limits on ALP-two-photon coupling g_agamma from radiative decay of ALP DM in five dwarf spheroidal galaxies (combined analysis, NFW profile), mass range 2.7-5.3 eV. Numerical values approximate, read from Figs. 2 and 5 (combined limits around 1e-12 GeV^-1, improving slightly with mass). Bounds derived assuming ALPs constitute all DM but exact local density not stated (uses dwarf D-factors), so dm_density left null. | selector: text (sole candidate)
